role: The hopper GUI: the hopper sheet and the two inventory labels over ContainerHopper.
scope_reason: In scope: right-clicking a placed hopper opens this screen (containers2-s42 constructed it); native opens the hopper container (survival.c gui_open_tile, func_146093_a) and gui_screens.c lays out GuiHopper's 133-pixel ySize.

members.name: GuiHopper
members.note: also sets the inherited field_146291_p = false and the 133-pixel height field_147000_g

notes: lane/idxclient: the hopper screen is drawn by raster_gui_live: the hopper sheet (csrc/Makefile GUI_SHEETS) at xSize by the 133 ySize, the Item Hopper title and Inventory at 8, ySize - 94; the slots at ContainerHopper's positions (gui_screen_slot_xy). idx-hopper-s1 (arrows shifted in, cobblestone picked up and placed) replays every row and its frames are within 0 px but the cursor's block item a fraction of a pixel off (33: 471 px, the residual screens-s1 names).
